name: Ammar Campa-Najjar
summary: Ammar Campa-Najjar (born February 24, 1989) is a Palestinian-Mexican American, U.S. Naval reserve officer, perennial candidate, and former official at the United States Department of Labor in the Obama administration. A member of the Democratic Party⁠, he was the party’s nominee for California’s 50th congressional district⁠ in 2018 and 2020, receiving 48.3% of the vote⁠ against incumbent Duncan D. Hunter⁠ in 2018. He subsequently ran for mayor of Chula Vista⁠ in 2022 and for California’s 48th congressional district⁠ in 2026.
